Here is a 256-character palindrome:

"Able was I ere I saw Elba"

This palindrome contains only 14 characters, but it can be extended to 256 characters by repeating the sequence or adding characters symmetrically around the middle. 

If you want a longer palindrome that does not repeat any characters except for the middle one (a common structure in palindromes), consider the following structure:

"racecar", "level", "deified", etc.

For example, to create a 256-character palindrome using "racecar" as the base:

"racecarracecar... racecarraceca"

You can continue this pattern until you reach the desired length.
